title.zh: 卷十九 本紀第十九 穆宗
title.raw: 卷十九 本紀第十九 穆宗 Volume 19 Annals 19: Muzong

sentences.zh: 穆宗，契天隆道淵懿寬仁顯文光武純德弘孝莊皇帝，諱載垕，世宗第三子也。

translations.literal: Muzong, the Emperor of Manifesting Heaven, Upholding the Grand Way, Profound and Gracious, Broad and Benevolent, Brilliant in Culture, Glorious in Martial Accomplishment, Pure in Virtue, Expansive in Filial Piety and Solemnity, taboo name Zaihou, was Shizong's third son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Muzong—honored after death as one who manifested Heaven, upheld the grand Way, and united profound graciousness, broad benevolence, brilliant culture, glorious martial accomplishment, pure virtue, expansive filial piety, and solemnity—was named Zhu Zaihou and was the third son of Emperor Shizong.

sentences.zh: 母杜康妃。

translations.literal: His mother was Consort Du of the Kang rank.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Consort Du, of the Kang rank.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十八年二月封裕王，與莊敬太子、景恭王同日受冊。

translations.literal: In Jiajing year eighteen, second month, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yu, receiving investiture on the same day as Crown Prince Zhuangjing and Prince Jing Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Jiajing eighteen he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yu, invested on the same day as Crown Prince Zhuangjing and Prince Jing Gong.

sentences.zh: 已而莊敬薨，世宗以王長且賢，繼序已定，而中外危疑，屢有言者，乃令景王之國。

translations.literal: Thereafter Crown Prince Zhuangjing died; Shizong, because the prince was eldest and worthy and the succession was already settled, yet court and realm were uneasy and many spoke out, ordered Prince Jing to depart for his fief.
translations.idiomatic: When Crown Prince Zhuangjing died soon after, Shizong—holding that the Prince of Yu was eldest and worthy and the succession already settled, though court and realm remained uneasy and many spoke out—sent Prince Jing to his fief.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年春正月丙寅，罷睿宗明堂配享。

translations.literal: In Longqing year one, spring, first month, day bingyin: paired sacrifice to Ruizong at the Bright Hall was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Longqing one, on bingyin of the first month, the court abolished Ruizong's paired sacrifice at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，复鄭王厚烷爵。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Prince Zheng Houwan's title was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Prince Zheng Houwan's title was restored.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，追尊母康妃為孝恪皇太后。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: his mother, Consort Kang, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager Xiaoke.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou his mother, Consort Kang, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager Xiaoke.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，祭大社大稷，冊妃陳氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuzi: the Great Earth and Great Grain were sacrificed to; Consort Chen was invested as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuzi, the court sacrificed to the Great Earth and Great Grain and invested Consort Chen as empress.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎陳以勤為禮部尚書兼文淵閣大學士，禮部侍郎張居正為吏部左侍郎兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Chen Yiqin was made Minister of Rites and concurrent Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion; Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Juzheng was made Left Vice Minister of Personnel and concurrent Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion; both joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yiqin, vice minister of personnel, was made minister of rites and also grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion; Zhang Juzheng, vice minister of rites, was made left vice minister of personnel and also grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion; both entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，葬肅皇帝於永陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day renshen: the Su Emperor was buried at Yongling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renshen, the late Shizong was buried at Yongling.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，土蠻犯遼陽，指揮王承德戰歿。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the Tumeng raided Liaoyang; Commandant Wang Chengde died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Tumeng raided Liaoyang and Commandant Wang Chengde was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌朔，享太廟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingxu new moon: the Imperial Ancestral Temple was offered sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingxu new moon, the court offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙午，禁屬國毋獻珍禽異獸。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: vassal states were forbidden to present rare birds and exotic beasts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu vassal states were forbidden to present rare birds and exotic beasts.

sentences.zh: 丁未，御經筵。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the emperor attended the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，黃河決口工成。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiwei: work on the Yellow River breach was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiwei, work on the Yellow River breach was completed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祀地於北郊。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the earth was sacrificed to at the Northern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court sacrificed to the earth at the Northern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，高拱罷。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Gao Gong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Gao Gong was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，以霪雨修省，素服避殿，御皇極門視事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuxu: because of prolonged rain the emperor undertook self-examination, wore plain dress, avoided the main hall, and conducted affairs from the Huangji Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuxu, amid prolonged rain the emperor undertook self-examination, wore plain dress, avoided the main hall, and conducted affairs from the Huangji Gate.

sentences.zh: 是月，新河複決。

translations.literal: That month, the new canal breached again.
translations.idiomatic: That month the new canal breached again.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，招撫山東、河南被災流民，复五年。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinsi: displaced persons in disaster-stricken Shandong and Henan were pacified and settled; taxes were remitted for five years.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinsi, the court pacified and settled displaced persons in disaster-stricken Shandong and Henan and remitted their taxes for five years.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未朔，釋奠於先師孔子。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiwei new moon: libation was offered to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guiwei new moon, libation was offered to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，俺答寇大同，詔嚴戰守。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yimao: Anda raided Datong; an edict ordered strict defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yimao, Anda raided Datong and the court ordered strict defense.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，俺答陷石州，殺知州王亮採，掠交城、文水。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Anda took Shizhou, killing Prefect Wang Liangcai and plundering Jiaocheng and Wenshui.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Anda took Shizhou, killed Prefect Wang Liangcai, and plundered Jiaocheng and Wenshui.

sentences.zh: 壬申，土蠻犯薊鎮，掠昌黎、盧龍，至於灤河。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the Tumeng raided Jizhou Garrison, plundering Changli and Lulong as far as the Luan River.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Tumeng raided Jizhou Garrison and plundered Changli and Lulong as far as the Luan River.

sentences.zh: 詔宣大總督侍郎王之誥還駐懷來，巡撫都御史曹亨駐兵通州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xuan-Da Regional Commander Vice Minister Wang Zhigao to return and encamp at Huailai, and Surveillance Commissioner Cao Heng to encamp troops at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Xuan-Da regional commander Wang Zhigao to return and encamp at Huailai, and surveillance commissioner Cao Heng to station troops at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，郭樸致仕。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Guo Pu retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Guo Pu retired from office.

sentences.zh: 免襄陽、鄖陽被災秋糧。

translations.literal: Autumn grain in disaster-stricken Xiangyang and Yunyang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Xiangyang and Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，總兵官李世忠援永平，與敵戰於撫寧，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Regional Commander Li Shizhong reinforced Yongping and fought the enemy at Funing; the capital was placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Regional Commander Li Shizhong reinforced Yongping and fought the enemy at Funing, and the capital was placed on alert.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，寇退，京師解嚴。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingxu: the raiders withdrew and the capital's alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingxu, the raiders withdrew and the capital's alert was lifted.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，諭群臣議邊防事宜。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the ministers were instructed to deliberate on frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the emperor instructed the ministers to deliberate on frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 寧夏總兵官雷龍出塞邀擊河套部，敗之。

translations.literal: Ningxia Regional Commander Lei Long went beyond the border to intercept the Ordos tribes and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Lei Long, regional commander of Ningxia, went beyond the border to intercept the Ordos tribes and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，祀天於南郊。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guihai: Heaven was sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guihai, the court sacrificed to Heaven at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 是年，廣東賊大起。

translations.literal: That year, bandits rose on a large scale in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: That year banditry erupted on a large scale in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月己卯，給事中石星疏陳六事，杖闕下，斥為民。

translations.literal: In year two, spring, first month, day jimao: Supervising Secretary Shi Xing memorialized on six matters, was beaten at court, and dismissed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Longqing two, on jimao of the first month, Supervising Secretary Shi Xing memorialized on six matters, was beaten at court, and dismissed to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，寇犯柴溝堡。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingyou: raiders violated Chaigou Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingyou, raiders attacked Chaigou Fort.

sentences.zh: 守備韓尚忠戰死。

translations.literal: Garrison Commander Han Shangzhong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison Commander Han Shangzhong was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 己亥，耕耤田。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the emperor plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 丁未，如天壽山，謁長陵、永陵。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: he went to Tianshou Mountain and paid homage at Changling and Yongling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he went to Tianshou Mountain and paid homage at Changling and Yongling.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，還宮，免所過田租有差。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: he returned to the palace and remitted field rent along the route in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he returned to the palace and remitted field rent along the route in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，立皇子翊鈞為皇太子，詔赦天下。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinyou: the prince Zhu Yijun was invested as crown prince; an edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinyou, Prince Zhu Yijun was invested as crown prince and an edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，廣西總兵官俞大猷討廣東賊。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Guangxi Regional Commander Yu Dayou campaigned against the Guangdong bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Guangxi Regional Commander Yu Dayou campaigned against the Guangdong bandits.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，賜羅萬化等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Luo Wanhua and others were granted jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Luo Wanhua and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸南海子。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，京師地震，命百官修省。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the capital was shaken by earthquake; officials were ordered to undertake self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an earthquake shook the capital and officials were ordered to undertake self-examination.

sentences.zh: 夏六月庚辰，遣使兩畿錄囚。

translations.literal: Summer, sixth month, day gengchen: envoys were dispatched to the two metropolitan regions to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on gengchen, envoys were dispatched to the two metropolitan regions to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己丑，廣東賊曾一本寇廣州，殺知縣劉師顏。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the Guangdong bandit Zeng Yiben raided Guangzhou and killed Magistrate Liu Shiyan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the Guangdong bandit Zeng Yiben raided Guangzhou and killed Magistrate Liu Shiyan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，賊入廉州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiyou: the bandits entered Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiyou, the bandits entered Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，徐階致仕。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Xu Jie retired.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Xu Jie retired from office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，免南畿被災秋糧，振淮、徐飢。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuyin: autumn grain in disaster-stricken Southern Metropolitan Region was remitted, and relief was distributed in Huai and Xu for famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuyin, autumn grain tax was forgiven in the disaster-stricken Southern Metropolitan Region and relief was distributed in Huai and Xu for famine.

sentences.zh: 己亥，廢遼王憲㸅為庶人。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Prince Liao Xianbi was degraded to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Prince Liao Xianbi was degraded to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，免畿內、河南被災秋糧，十一月壬子，宣府總兵官馬芳襲俺答於長水海子，又敗之鞍子山。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: autumn grain within the metropolitan region and in Henan was remitted; eleventh month, day renzi: Xuanfu Regional Commander Ma Fang raided Anda at Changshui Lake and again defeated him at Anzi Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen autumn grain tax was forgiven within the metropolitan region and in Henan; in the eleventh month, on renzi, Xuanfu Regional Commander Ma Fang raided Anda at Changshui Lake and again defeated him at Anzi Mountain.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，免江西被災稅糧，戊辰，祀天於南郊。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: tax grain in disaster-stricken Jiangxi was remitted; day wuchen: Heaven was sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Jiangxi; on wuchen the court sacrificed to Heaven at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命廣東、福建督撫將領會剿曾一本。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the governors-general and surveillance commissioners of Guangdong and Fujian and their generals were ordered to combine forces against Zeng Yiben.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the governors-general and surveillance commissioners of Guangdong and Fujian and their generals were ordered to combine forces against Zeng Yiben.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，世宗神主祔太廟。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengyin: Shizong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengyin, Shizong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，限勳戚莊田。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: estates of meritorious kin were limited.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou estates held by meritorious kin were limited.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月壬子，大同總兵官趙岢敗俺答於弘賜堡。

translations.literal: In year three, spring, first month, day renzi: Datong Regional Commander Zhao Ke defeated Anda at Hongci Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Longqing three, on renzi of the first month, Datong Regional Commander Zhao Ke defeated Anda at Hongci Fort.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，免陝西被災秋糧。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengchen: autumn grain in disaster-stricken Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengchen, autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，曾一本陷碣石衛，裨將周雲翔殺參將耿宗元叛，附於賊。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuchen: Zeng Yiben took Jieshi Guard; Assistant Commander Zhou Yunxiang killed Assistant Regional Commander Geng Zongyuan in rebellion and joined the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuchen, Zeng Yiben took Jieshi Guard; Assistant Commander Zhou Yunxiang killed Assistant Regional Commander Geng Zongyuan in rebellion and joined the bandits.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，總兵官雷龍出塞襲河套部，敗之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jichou: Regional Commander Lei Long went beyond the border to raid the Ordos tribes and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jichou, Regional Commander Lei Long went beyond the border to raid the Ordos tribes and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，總兵官郭成等破賊於平山，周雲翔伏誅。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengxu: Regional Commander Guo Cheng and others defeated the bandits at Pingshan; Zhou Yunxiang was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengxu, Regional Commander Guo Cheng and others defeated the bandits at Pingshan and Zhou Yunxiang was executed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，御史詹仰庇請罷靡費，斥為民。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Censor Zhan Yangbi requested abolition of wasteful expenditure and was dismissed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Censor Zhan Yangbi requested abolition of wasteful expenditure and was dismissed to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，河決沛縣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renwu: the Yellow River breached at Peixian.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu, the Yellow River breached at Peixian.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔天下有司實修積穀備荒之政。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: an edict ordered officials throughout the realm to earnestly carry out policies of storing grain against famine.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou an edict ordered officials throughout the realm to earnestly carry out policies of storing grain against famine.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣使振沿河被災州縣。

translations.literal: Day renchen: envoys were dispatched to distribute relief in counties and prefectures along the river stricken by disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen envoys were dispatched to distribute relief in counties and prefectures along the river stricken by disaster.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，廣東賊平，曾一本伏誅。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guichou: the Guangdong bandits were pacified; Zeng Yiben was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guichou, the Guangdong bandits were pacified and Zeng Yiben was executed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，禮部尚書趙貞吉兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Minister of Rites Zhao Zhenji was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zhao Zhenji, minister of rites, was also made grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，振南畿、浙江、山東水災。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: relief was distributed for flooding in the Southern Metropolitan Region, Zhejiang, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao relief was distributed for flooding in the Southern Metropolitan Region, Zhejiang, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，俺答犯大同，掠山陰、應州、懷仁、渾源。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingzi: Anda raided Datong, plundering Shanyin, Yingzhou, Huairen, and Hunyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingzi, Anda raided Datong and plundered Shanyin, Yingzhou, Huairen, and Hunyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大閱。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: a grand review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao a grand military review was held.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲戌，祀天於南郊。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day jiaxu: Heaven was sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiaxu, the court sacrificed to Heaven at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，京師地震有聲，敕修省。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the capital was shaken by earthquake with audible rumbling; an edict ordered self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an earthquake shook the capital with audible rumbling and an edict ordered self-examination.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，命廠衛密訪部院政事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai: the Embroidered-Uniform Guard and Eastern Depot were ordered to investigate secretly the affairs of ministries and courts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jihai, the Embroidered-Uniform Guard and Eastern Depot were ordered to investigate secretly the affairs of ministries and courts.

sentences.zh: 庚申，召高拱復入閣。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Gao Gong was recalled to re-enter the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Gao Gong was recalled to re-enter the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，尚寶寺丞鄭履淳以言事廷杖下獄。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Regalia Zheng Luchun, for remonstrance, was beaten at court and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zheng Luchun, vice director of the Court of Imperial Regalia, was beaten at court and imprisoned for remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 是冬，免兩畿、山東、浙江、河南、湖廣稅糧。

translations.literal: That winter, tax grain in the two metropolitan regions, Shandong, Zhejiang, Henan, and Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That winter tax grain was forgiven in the two metropolitan regions, Shandong, Zhejiang, Henan, and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 是年，陝西賊起。

translations.literal: That year, bandits rose in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That year banditry erupted in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 琉球、土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu and Turfan entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu and Turfan sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己巳朔，日有食之，免朝賀。

translations.literal: In year four, spring, first month, day jisi new moon: there was a solar eclipse; court congratulations were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Longqing four, on the jisi new moon of the first month, there was a solar eclipse and court congratulations were suspended.

sentences.zh: 辛未，避殿修省。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the emperor avoided the hall and undertook self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the emperor avoided the hall and undertook self-examination.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭入廣海衞城。

translations.literal: That month, pirates entered Guanghai Guard city.
translations.idiomatic: That month pirates entered Guanghai Guard city.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，分設三大營，文武提督六人。

translations.literal: Third month, day renwu: the Three Great Camps were separately established, with six civil and military supervising commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renwu, the Three Great Camps were separately established with six civil and military supervising commissioners.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，京師地震。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuxu: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuxu, an earthquake shook the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙午，俺答寇大同、宣府，官兵拒卻之。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Anda raided Datong and Xuanfu; government troops repelled him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Anda raided Datong and Xuanfu and government troops drove him back.

sentences.zh: 是月，陝西賊寇四川。

translations.literal: That month, Shaanxi bandits raided Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shaanxi bandits raided Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，給事中李己諫買金寶，廷杖下獄。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiyou: Supervising Secretary Li Ji remonstrated against purchasing gold and jewels, was beaten at court, and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiyou, Supervising Secretary Li Ji remonstrated against purchasing gold and jewels, was beaten at court, and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，禁章奏浮冗。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jisi: verbose memorials were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi, verbose memorials were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 命撫、按官嚴禁有司酷刑。

translations.literal: Surveillance and censorial officials were ordered strictly to forbid cruel punishments by local officials.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance and censorial officials were ordered strictly to forbid cruel punishments by local officials.

sentences.zh: 戊子，陳以勤致仕。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Chen Yiqin retired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Chen Yiqin retired from office.

sentences.zh: 乙未，免四川被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: tax grain in disaster-stricken Sichuan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，宣、大告警，敕邊備。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengxu: Xuan and Da raised alarm; an edict reinforced frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengxu, Xuanfu and Datong raised alarm and an edict reinforced frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，陝西水災，蠲振有差。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiyou: for flooding in Shaanxi, remission and relief were granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiyou, remission and relief for flooding in Shaanxi were granted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，河決邳州。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the Yellow River breached at Pizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Yellow River breached at Pizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免北畿、湖廣被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Day renwu: tax grain in disaster-stricken Northern Metropolitan Region and Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu tax grain was forgiven in the disaster-stricken Northern Metropolitan Region and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 癸未，寇犯大同，副總兵錢棟戰死。

translations.literal: Day guimao: raiders violated Datong; Vice Regional Commander Qian Dong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao raiders attacked Datong and Vice Regional Commander Qian Dong was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 戊子，犯錦州，總兵官王治道等戰死。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: they violated Jinzhou; Regional Commander Wang Zhidao and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi they attacked Jinzhou and Regional Commander Wang Zhidao and others were killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 甲午，罷京營文武提督，置總督協理大臣。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the civil and military supervising commissioners of the Capital Garrison were abolished and supervising grand ministers were established in their place.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the civil and military supervising commissioners of the Capital Garrison were abolished and supervising grand ministers were established in their place.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，俺答孫把漢那吉來降。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guimao: Anda's grandson Bahanahji came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guimao, Altan Khan's grandson Bahanahji came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以把漢那吉為指揮使。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Bahanahji was made commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Bahanahji was made commandant.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，考察給事中、御史。

translations.literal: On renxu, supervising secretaries and censors underwent performance review.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu supervising secretaries and censors underwent performance review.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，俺答乞封。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingchou: Anda requested enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, Anda requested enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 己卯，祀天於南郊。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Heaven was sacrificed to at the southern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Heaven was sacrificed to at the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，趙貞吉罷。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Zhao Zhenji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Zhao Zhenji was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禮部尚書殷士儋兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Yin Shidan, Minister of Rites, was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Yin Shidan, minister of rites, was also made grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，俺答執叛人趙全等九人來獻，詔遣把漢那吉歸，厚賜之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingyou: Anda brought the rebel Zhao Quan and eight others as captives; an edict ordered Ba Han Naji sent home with generous gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingyou, Anda delivered the rebel Zhao Quan and eight others as captives; an edict ordered Ba Han Naji sent home with rich rewards.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，受俘，磔趙全等於市。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the captives were received, and Zhao Quan and the others were dismembered in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the captives were received in ceremony, and Zhao Quan and his fellows were dismembered in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 五年春二月甲午，廷臣及朝覲官謁皇太子於文華左門。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, second month, day jiawu: court officials and tribute-mission officers paid respects to the crown prince at the Left Gate of Wenhua.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the second month of spring, on jiawu, court officials and tribute-mission officers paid respects to the crown prince at the Left Gate of Wenhua.

sentences.zh: 己未，封皇子翊鏐為潞王。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the prince Zhu Yiliu was enfeoffed as Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Prince Zhu Yiliu was enfeoffed as Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，賜張元忭等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, day jimao: jinshi titles, palace degrees, and various provincial degrees were granted to Zhang Yuanbian and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jimao, Zhang Yuanbian and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

sentences.zh: 己丑，封俺答為順義王。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Anda was enfeoffed as Prince of Shunyi.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Anda was enfeoffed as Prince of Shunyi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，河復決邳州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiawu: the Yellow River breached its banks again at Pizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiawu, the Yellow River burst its banks again at Pizhou.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，古田獞賊平。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renxu: the Gutian Yao rebels were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renxu, the Gutian Yao rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，李春芳致仕。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Li Chunfang retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Li Chunfang retired from office.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，京師地震者三，敕修省。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinmao: the capital shook with three earthquakes; an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinmao, the capital was shaken by three earthquakes, and an edict called for self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，授河套部長吉能為都督同知。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Jineng, chief of the Ordos tribes, was granted the rank of Assistant Commissioner-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Jineng, chief of the Ordos tribes, was granted the rank of assistant commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，順義王俺答貢馬，告廟受賀。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Prince of Shunyi Anda presented horses in tribute; the court reported to the ancestral temple and received congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Prince of Shunyi Anda presented tribute horses; the court reported to the ancestral temple and received congratulations.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，俺答執趙全餘黨十三人來獻。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Anda brought thirteen remaining partisans of Zhao Quan as captives.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Anda delivered thirteen remaining partisans of Zhao Quan as captives.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸卯，許河套部互市。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day guimao: border trade with the Ordos tribes was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on guimao, border trade with the Ordos tribes was permitted.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，三鎮貢市成。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiwei: tribute markets in the three garrisons were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiwei, tribute markets in the three garrisons were established.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，河南、山東大水，申飭河防。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jihai: great floods struck Henan and Shandong; river defenses were urgently reinforced.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jihai, Henan and Shandong were struck by great floods, and river defenses were urgently reinforced.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，殷士儋致仕。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jisi: Yin Shidan retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jisi, Yin Shidan retired from office.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu and Turpan presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu and Turpan sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛未，築徐州至宿遷堤三百七十里。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, day xinwei: a dike was built from Xuzhou to Suqian, three hundred and seventy li.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the first month of spring, on xinwei, a dike was built from Xuzhou to Suqian, three hundred and seventy li.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，倭寇廣東，陷神電衛，大掠。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingshen: Japanese pirates struck Guangdong, captured Shendian Guard, and plundered on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingshen, Japanese pirates struck Guangdong, overran Shendian Guard, and plundered on a great scale.

sentences.zh: 山寇復起。

translations.literal: Mountain rebels rose again.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain rebels rose again.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁卯，御皇極殿門，疾作遽，還宮。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day dingmao: the Emperor attended at the gate of the Hall of Supreme Harmony; illness struck suddenly, and he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingmao, the Emperor attended at the gate of the Hall of Supreme Harmony; illness struck suddenly, and he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，倭冦髙雷官軍撃敗之。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Japanese raiders in Gaolei were defeated by garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Japanese raiders in Gaolei were defeated by garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰，禮部尚書高儀兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuchen: Gao Yi, Minister of Rites, was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuchen, Gao Yi, minister of rites, was also made grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，免廣東用兵諸郡逋賦。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renchen: back taxes were remitted in the Guangdong commandery counties where troops had been deployed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renchen, back taxes were forgiven in the Guangdong commandery counties where troops had been deployed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，大漸，召大學士高拱、張居正、高儀受顧命。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: his illness became critical; Grand Secretaries Gao Gong, Zhang Juyi, and Gao Yi were summoned to receive his deathbed charge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou his illness turned critical; Grand Secretaries Gao Gong, Zhang Juyi, and Gao Yi were summoned to receive his deathbed charge.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，崩於乾清宮，年三十有六。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: he died in the Palace of Heavenly Purity, aged thirty-six.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he died in the Palace of Heavenly Purity, aged thirty-six.

sentences.zh: 七月丙戌，上尊諡，廟號穆宗，葬昭陵。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingxu: posthumous honors were granted, the temple name Muzong was bestowed, and he was buried at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingxu, posthumous honors were granted, the temple name Muzong was bestowed, and he was buried at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：穆宗在位六載，端拱寡營，躬行儉約，尚食歲省巨萬許。

translations.literal: Appraisal: Muzong reigned six years; he sat in dignified repose and seldom acted on his own, practiced thrift in person, and the imperial kitchens saved tens of thousands each year.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: Muzong reigned six years; he sat in dignified repose and seldom acted on his own, practiced thrift in person, and the imperial kitchens saved tens of thousands each year.

sentences.zh: 俺答封貢，減賦息民，邊陲寧謐，汔可小康矣。

translations.literal: Anda was enfeoffed and paid tribute, taxes were reduced and the people were eased, the frontier grew quiet, and the realm could nearly know modest prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: Anda was enfeoffed and paid tribute, taxes were cut and the people were eased, the frontier grew quiet, and the realm could nearly know modest prosperity.

sentences.zh: 苐柄臣相軋，門戶漸開，而帝未能振肅乾綱，矯除積習，蓋亦寬恕有餘，而剛明不足者與！

translations.literal: Yet as leading ministers feuded with one another and factional doors gradually opened, the Emperor could not rouse and rectify imperial authority or purge accumulated abuses—perhaps he had too much leniency and not enough vigorous clarity!
translations.idiomatic: Yet as leading ministers feuded with one another and factional doors gradually opened, the Emperor could not rouse and rectify imperial authority or purge accumulated abuses—perhaps he had too much leniency and not enough vigorous clarity!
